relations.text: 2011年にダウとサウジアラビア国営石油会社が合弁会社サダラを設立した
relations.text_en: Dow and Saudi Arabian Oil Company formed the Sadara joint venture in 2011

source.label: Dow 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: In 2011, the Company and Saudi Arabian Oil Company formed Sadara - a joint venture between the two companies that constructed and operates a world-scale, fully integrated chemicals complex in Jubail Industrial City, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

relations.text: 2021年にダウとサウジアラビア国営石油会社はサダラ製品の販売権の移管計画で合意した
relations.text_en: In 2021, Dow and Saudi Arabian Oil Company agreed to a marketing rights transition plan

source.label: Dow 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: In 2021, Dow and the Saudi Arabian Oil Company agreed to a marketing rights transition plan.

relations.text: ダウはサダラに35%を出資し、製品の相当部分を自社の販路で販売している
relations.text_en: Dow holds a 35 percent equity interest in Sadara and markets a significant portion of its products

source.label: Dow 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: The Company has a 35 percent equity interest in this joint venture and continues to be responsible for marketing a significant portion of Sadara’s products through the Company’s established sales channels.

companies.name: イクエート・ペトロケミカル

relations.text: クウェートのエチレン・ポリエチレン製造会社で、ダウが42.5%を保有する
relations.text_en: Kuwait-based ethylene and polyethylene maker in which Dow owns 42.5 percent

source.label: Dow 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: EQUATE Petrochemical Company K.S.C.C. (“EQUATE”) - a Kuwait-based company that manufactures ethylene, polyethylene and ethylene glycol, and manufactures and markets monoethylene glycol, diethylene glycol and polyethylene terephthalate resins; owned 42.5 percent by the Company.

companies.name: クウェート・スチレン

relations.text: クウェートでスチレンモノマーを製造する会社で、ダウが42.5%を保有する
relations.text_en: Kuwait-based styrene monomer maker in which Dow owns 42.5 percent

source.label: Dow 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: The Kuwait Styrene Company K.S.C.C. - a Kuwait-based company that manufactures styrene monomer; owned 42.5 percent by the Company.

relations.text: タイでポリエチレンやスチレンなどを製造する企業群で、ダウが50%を保有する
relations.text_en: Thailand-based group making polyethylene and styrene, 50 percent owned by Dow

source.label: Dow 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: The SCGC-Dow Group - a group of Thailand-based companies (consisting of Siam Polyethylene Company Limited; Siam Polystyrene Company Limited; Siam Styrene Monomer Company Limited; and Siam Synthetic Latex Company Limited) that manufactures polyethylene, polystyrene, styrene, latex and specialty elastomers; owned 50 percent by the Company.
